newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 6.721 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 84-day T-bills yield 6.721 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 84-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.721 percent versus 6.875 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The Reserve Bank accepted only NZ$90 million of bids on its offering of $150 million of 28-day seasonal treasury bills, which had a weighted average successful yield of 6.780 percent.

The bank over-accepted bids on its offering of $150 million 49-day treasury bills. It accepted $210 million of the bids, from offers of $375 million. The 49-day bills had a weighted average successful yield of 6.772 percent.
